mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuation multiples, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing forward discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in high-rate periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, prompting equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.0% triggers a risk-on equity reaction, compressing forward discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 triggers a supply-side shock, compressing forward discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in retail sales (HOUST) above 500.0 units signals consumer demand strength, prompting equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 200.0 indicates a disinflationary environment, lowering equity valuation multiples and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 3-month moving average of industrial production (GDPC1) below 12,973.0 suggests weakening demand, compressing forward discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
